tool_schemas.name: contacts
tool_schemas.description: Manage contacts in a workspace: list returns a cursor-paged result set (limit + cursor) with optional query/sort/filter fields; get/create/update/delete return the contact record (or deletion tombstone where applicable); import creates an import job from the provided import_job payload and returns the job record/status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required identifiers for an action are missing (e.g., contact_id for get/update/delete, import_job.input_format/raw_input for import), when ids don’t match their brv_* patterns, or when limit/sort/status/source enums are invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to access the workspace; raises NOT_FOUND when the workspace_id or contact_id does not exist in that workspace. Raises CONFLICT when create/import would violate the selected dedupe_strategy or when delete/update targets a contact in a state that cannot transition (for example, already deleted).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (brv_wsp_...) to scope the operation.

email.description: Contact email address (used for create or filtering).

phone_e164.description: Contact phone number in E.164 format.

attributes.description: Custom attribute payload for the contact.

list_ids.description: List ids to set on the contact.

status.description: Contact status (used for create/update or filtering).

source.description: Contact source (used for create/update or filtering).

external_ids.description: External identifiers map (e.g., ecommerce customer id, crm id).

created_by_principal_id.description: Principal id (brv_prn_...) that created the contact.

updated_by_principal_id.description: Principal id (brv_prn_...) that last updated the contact.

query.description: Free-text query to search contacts (typically name/email/phone).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

import_job.description: Contact import job payload for action=import.

attribute_mapping.description: Mapping from input columns/keys to contact fields/attributes.

target_list_ids.description: List ids to add imported contacts to.

dedupe_strategy.description: How to handle duplicates during import.

tool_schemas.name: email
tool_schemas.description: Transactional email operations for a workspace: send creates a message/send record (optionally scheduled_for) and returns it; template actions create/update/get return the template messaging object; list_templates and list_events return cursor-paged collections (limit + cursor) ordered by sort_by/sort_order; track_event records an event against a message/template and returns the recorded event. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields for an action are missing (e.g., template_id for get/update/send-with-template, to_contact_id or to_address for send, event_type/event_at for track_event), when ids don’t match brv_* patterns, or when scheduling/tracking fields are malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for access violations to the workspace. Raises NOT_FOUND when workspace_id, template_id, or message_id does not exist in the workspace; raises CONFLICT when attempting to update a template in a non-editable status (e.g., archived/deleted) or when recording an event that is not applicable to the message’s lifecycle/state.

action.description: Which transactional email operation to perform.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (brv_wsp_...) to scope the operation.

message_id.description: Messaging object id (brv_msg_...) for existing email send/event/template.

template_id.description: Template messaging object id (brv_msg_...) to use for send/get/update.

to_address.description: Recipient email address (if not using to_contact_id).

payload.description: Provider/send payload (template variables, html/text, headers, etc.).

send_provider_message_id.description: Provider message id to correlate with events.

event_type.description: Event type to record or filter.

status.description: Messaging status (used for template lifecycle or filtering).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: campaigns
tool_schemas.description: Create and operate email/SMS/WhatsApp campaigns in a workspace: list returns cursor-paged campaigns (limit + cursor) with optional status/channel sorting; get/create/update return the campaign messaging object; schedule/send/pause/archive perform the state transition and return the updated campaign. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing for an action (e.g., campaign_id for get/update/schedule/send/pause/archive, scheduled_for for schedule), when ids don’t match brv_* patterns, or when channel/status/sort/limit values are invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot act in the workspace. Raises NOT_FOUND when workspace_id or campaign_id is unknown; raises CONFLICT when a requested transition is not allowed (e.g., sending a draft without required content, scheduling an already sent/archived campaign, pausing a campaign that is not currently sending/scheduled, or updating an archived/deleted campaign).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (brv_wsp_...) to scope the operation.

campaign_id.description: Campaign messaging object id (brv_msg_...) for get/update/schedule/send.

from_email.description: Email sender address for the campaign.

from_name.description: Email sender name for the campaign.

template_id.description: Template id (brv_msg_...) used by the campaign.

status.description: Campaign status (used for create/update or filtering).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: events
tool_schemas.description: Tracks and retrieves messaging and custom events for a workspace: `track` creates a new event record (including `custom` payloads), `list` returns a cursor-paged list filtered by `event_type` and/or `to_contact_id` with `limit`, `cursor`, `sort`, and `order`, and `get` returns a single event by `id`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, ids don’t match the expected patterns, `limit`/sort/order are out of range, or `track` is called without a valid body (for custom tracking, `body.event_type` must be `custom`). Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot access the workspace, NOT_FOUND when the workspace, contact, or event id does not exist (or is not in the workspace), and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the workspace has reached its daily events allowance.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id owning the events.

id.description: Custom event messaging object id (for get).

event_type.description: Event type to filter by or set when tracking.

to_contact_id.description: Contact id associated with the event (filter or set).

event_at.description: Timestamp for the event (primarily for track).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

event_type.description: Event type for custom tracking (always custom).

to_contact_id.description: Contact id associated with this event.

tool_schemas.name: inbound
tool_schemas.description: Receives and manages inbound email records for a workspace: `receive` stores an inbound message from the provided body, `process` updates an existing inbound message’s processing status, `get` returns a single inbound record by `id`, and `list` returns a cursor-paged list filtered by `status` with `limit`, `cursor`, `sort`, and `order`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, ids don’t match the expected patterns, `limit`/sort/order are invalid, or a provided `status` is not allowed for the selected action. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot access the workspace, NOT_FOUND when the workspace or inbound message id does not exist (or is not in the workspace), and CONFLICT when `process` attempts an invalid state transition (for example, processing a deleted/archived message).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id owning inbound processing.

status.description: Status to filter by (for list actions) or set (for process).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

body.description: Inbound email content and attachments to store/process.

name.description: Name/subject label for the inbound email record.

to_address.description: Inbound recipient address that received the message.

attachments.description: List of attachment descriptors and/or extracted content.

conversation_thread_id.description: Conversation thread messaging object id to link to.

tool_schemas.name: enterprise
tool_schemas.description: Provides enterprise multi-tenant administration for workspaces and principals: workspace actions create/update/get/list workspaces, and principal actions create/update/get/list/disable principals (optionally scoped by `workspace_id`), with list endpoints returning cursor-paged results using `limit`, `cursor`, `sort`, and `order`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required identifiers are missing or malformed, when body fields don’t match the target resource (workspace vs principal), or when enum-constrained fields (e.g., principal `type`/`role`) are invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks enterprise admin privileges, NOT_FOUND when the referenced workspace or principal does not exist (or is not in scope), and CONFLICT when creating a principal with an email that already exists in the same workspace or when disabling a principal that is already disabled.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (for workspace-scoped principal operations or workspace get/update).

status.description: Status filter for list actions (workspace or principal depending on action).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

body.description: Workspace or principal fields to create/update.

default_sender_email.description: Default sender email for the workspace.

default_sender_name.description: Default sender name for the workspace.

quota_daily_emails.description: Daily email quota configured for the workspace.

quota_daily_sms.description: Daily SMS quota configured for the workspace.

quota_daily_whatsapp.description: Daily WhatsApp quota configured for the workspace.

quota_daily_events.description: Daily custom events quota configured for the workspace.

brevo_api_key_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the Brevo API key stored for the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id for creating a principal.

tool_schemas.name: bulk_contact_import
tool_schemas.description: Analyzes `raw_input` in the specified `input_format`, extracts contacts and attributes, applies the chosen `dedupe_strategy`, and imports the resulting contacts into the workspace and optional `target_list_ids` on behalf of `requested_by_principal_id`. Returns an import result summary (counts created/updated/skipped and any per-row errors) and fails fast when the input cannot be parsed or mapped. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when workspace/principal ids are invalid, `input_format` is unsupported, `raw_input` is empty/unparseable, or target list ids are not valid, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the principal cannot import into the workspace, NOT_FOUND when the workspace, principal, or a target list does not exist (or is not in the workspace), and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the workspace exceeds its contact or import limits.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id where contacts will be imported.

input_format.description: Format of the raw input being imported.

raw_input.description: Raw pasted text/CSV/JSON input to analyze and import.

target_list_ids.description: List ids to add imported contacts to.

dedupe_strategy.description: How to handle duplicates during import.

attribute_mapping.description: Mapping from detected fields/columns to contact fields/attributes.

tool_schemas.name: workspaces
tool_schemas.description: Manage workspaces for a Brevo MCP tenant: list returns a cursor-paged set with optional filters; get returns one workspace; create provisions a new workspace (initial status=active unless specified) and stores the Brevo API key fingerprint; update patches mutable fields and enforces status/quotas rules (e.g., cannot reduce quotas below usage_today, and sender/domain/folders changes require status=active). Refuses unauthorized mutations based on principal role and returns VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid transitions or payloads.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (brv_wsp_...) for get/update.

brevo_account_id.description: Brevo account/workspace identifier as known by Brevo (used for create/filtering).

default_sender_email.description: Default sender email (update allowed only when status=active).

default_sender_name.description: Default sender name (update allowed only when status=active).

verified_domains.description: Verified sending domains (update allowed only when status=active).

folders.description: Folder names/ids used for organization (update allowed only when status=active).

timezone.description: IANA timezone for scheduling and reporting (e.g., 'Europe/Paris').

quota_daily_emails.description: Daily email send quota; cannot be reduced below usage_today.emails_sent.

quota_daily_sms.description: Daily SMS send quota; cannot be reduced below usage_today.sms_sent.

quota_daily_whatsapp.description: Daily WhatsApp send quota; cannot be reduced below usage_today.whatsapp_sent.

quota_daily_events.description: Daily custom events ingest quota; cannot be reduced below usage_today.events_ingested.

brevo_api_key.description: Brevo API key used to operate this workspace; stored securely and only its fingerprint is exposed.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: principals
tool_schemas.description: Manage principals (users/service accounts) within a workspace: list returns a cursor-paged result set; get returns one principal; create invites or provisions a principal (status=invited by default) and returns the record; update patches role/display_name/status and enforces lifecycle transitions and authorization (read_only cannot mutate; support cannot change quotas or API credentials). Refuses invalid transitions with VALIDATION_ERROR.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (brv_wsp_...) to scope the operation.

email.description: Principal email (required for user create; filtering).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: business_objects
tool_schemas.description: Create and manage CRM/ecommerce entities (business_objects) within a workspace: list returns cursor-paged objects by type/status; get returns one object; create inserts a new object and enforces unique(workspace_id, object_type, external_id) when external_id is provided; update patches fields and supports status lifecycle transitions per object_type (e.g., deals open->won/lost, orders pending->paid/refunded/cancelled, active<->inactive). Refuses invalid transitions and invalid parent relationships (e.g., ecom_payment requires parent_object_id referencing an ecom_order).

action.description: Which business object operation to perform.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id (brv_wsp_...) to scope the operation.

amount.description: Monetary amount (e.g., deal value, order total, payment amount).

properties.description: Arbitrary object-specific properties (e.g., line items, stages, metadata).

external_id.description: External identifier for upsert-style integration (unique per workspace+object_type when present).

created_by_principal_id.description: Principal id that created the object (create).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: whoami
tool_schemas.description: Return the authenticated calling identity and entitlements: resolves the current principal (if any), its workspace membership, role, scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption for the workspace(s). Refuses requests with invalid/expired credentials and returns FORBIDDEN when the caller is not entitled to access the referenced workspace.

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace id to return workspace-scoped entitlements and quota usage.

include_workspaces.description: When true, include the list of workspaces the caller can access (cursor-paged).

limit.description: Maximum number of workspaces to return when include_workspaces=true.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page when include_workspaces=true.
